responsibility: Implements the rs6000/powerpc64le compatibility version of Intel SSE’s <xmmintrin.h>. It defines the __m128 and related unaligned/internal vector types, the standard SSE construction, load/store, shuffle, arithmetic, comparison, cache-control, fence, pause, and matrix-transpose interfaces, and maps them onto AltiVec/VSX builtins, PowerPC instructions, and helper headers such as mmintrin.h and mm_malloc.h. Within this module it is the specific header that provides the base single-precision SSE API and porting semantics for x86 XMM intrinsics, distinct from the later SSE2/SSE3/SSE4 compatibility layers in emmintrin.h, pmmintrin.h, tmmintrin.h, and smmintrin.h.
